constraints: No editor calls while Unreal is closed/building.
Use native Aura MCP only; no Computer Use.
PIE mutations must affect transient game instances, never the editor world, saved map or assets.
Direct receiver invocation validates receiver/AI integration; it does not prove microphone capture, speech recognition or voice RPC transport.

checks: Start only after native build and saved Blueprint compile succeed.
Confirm is_pie_active instances identifies client_index0 listen host and1 joined client; honor GPU capacity recommendation.
Survey each live world once to obtain exact ghost/player/controller names.
Wait at least0.6s for runtime endpoints; each server PlayerController should have MallVoiceTransport; each relevant ghost peer should have exactly one MallGhostVoice receiver.
Read capsule collision Pawn response on host and client. Native receiver BeginPlay should set Ignore on both.

native_api_notes.target_resolver: unreal.MallGhostVoiceReceiver.resolve_target_pawn(ghost) returns the authoritative eligible ACharacter; compare actual possessed player identities, not hardcoded player0.
native_api_notes.world_selection: Discover actual PIE UWorlds and net modes before any Python fallback; the receiver call must target the listen-server world and its actual remote player's server controller. Native MCP pie_scene_edit exposes call_actor_function, not a component function, so a narrowly scoped execute_unreal_python call is justified only for this unavailable component-call operation. Fetch Python best practices before first use; never access editor actors/assets or save.
native_api_notes.reads: get_actor_property_in_pie(name=exact_ghost, component='MallGhostVoice', properties=['ReactionCount','LastPhrase','LastSpeaker','LastReactionServerTime'], client_index=0 or1); actor properties include TargetPlayer, PrototypeState, CooldownUntil, HasValidatedPath, OutsideBoundViolations, CatchCount, CurrentValidWaypoints, LastValidatedGoal.
native_api_notes.recording: start_state_recording ghost root/component world position plus CooldownUntil/OutsideBoundViolations/CatchCount/HasValidatedPath. Use socket_tracks with actor root for world positions. Non-numeric TargetPlayer/LastPhrase require individual property reads.
native_api_notes.waits: Use wait_pie_seconds or sequence waits; never wait_pie_frames because it freezes the game thread.
native_api_notes.rpc_execution: Editor Python forces nested RPCs to execute locally through FEditorScriptExecutionGuard. Use a native DEFER KE call to a discovered PIE component path for owner-RPC checks; direct Python receiver calls establish receiver/AI behavior and replicated properties, not multicast effects or end-to-end transport.
native_api_notes.runtime_property_edits: For this isolated transient hearing-range test, set_editor_property(..., notify_mode=unreal.PropertyAccessChangeNotifyMode.NEVER) and restore in finally. Editor property notifications reconstruct the owning Blueprint and invalidate its runtime controller cache.

cases.arrange: Host at near loop point, remote at farther loop point, both inside. No recent come_here preference.
cases.act: Allow one server Tick; read TargetPlayer and ResolveTargetPawn.
cases.accept: Nearest eligible host pawn selected. Moving host outside selects actual remote pawn. Both outside returns no target and ghost returns home.

cases.arrange: Remote inside, host nearby, no phrase in previous1.1s.
cases.act: Invoke remote server controller phrase where_are_you, then give_me_a_sign after1.1s.
cases.accept: Each call returns true; server ReactionCount increments once; LastPhrase and LastSpeaker identify phrase and actual remote pawn; corresponding client receiver telemetry converges. Local pulse/text/chime should appear on both relevant peers; rendering/audio remains a separate observation.

cases.arrange: Move both players outside for baseline. Then move remote to each out-of-store/main-hall/neighbor point and finally upper-floor sameXY point.
cases.act: Invoke where_are_you with actual remote server PC at each point; read pre/post ReactionCount and return bool.
cases.accept: All return false, count unchanged, no cue. Upper-floor feet850 excluded by authored[-40,+450] ground-floor eligibility.

cases.act: Invoke unknown_phrase; invoke a valid phrase with confidence0.1; accept one valid phrase then immediately repeat within1s.
cases.accept: Unknown/low-confidence/immediate-repeat calls return false and do not add reactions. A later valid phrase after1.1s is accepted.

cases.arrange: Use clear interior poses separated beyond20m if validated by nav/capsule checks; otherwise temporarily reduce only this transient receiver HearingRangeCm to500 while speaker remains at a verified safe loop point more than500cm away. Restore original value after this isolated case.
cases.act: Invoke where_are_you beyond configured range, then move within range and retry after1.1s.
cases.accept: Outside configured range false/count unchanged; within range true. Do not claim real20m boundary was tested if using temporary500cm setting.

cases.arrange: Eligible player at least300cm from ghost so no catch/reset interferes. Observe active pursuit first.
cases.act: Start state recording; invoke leave_me_alone; record at0.25s intervals for at least3.5 game seconds.
cases.accept: Accepted once; ClearRoute stops movement, cooldown extends to at leastreactionTime+3s; no pursuit displacement during first3s (small floor-settle tolerance only). Pursuit resumes after cooldown if a player remains eligible. CatchCount/player health/position unchanged.

cases.arrange: Host nearer than remote, both eligible; verify target initially host.
cases.act: Invoke come_here from actual remote server PC. Allow one Tick, then observe target and validated path for several seconds.
cases.accept: Remote pawn becomes TargetPlayer despite host being nearer; replan uses existing BuildValidatedRoute and all copied points remain in store. Preference lasts up to12s while eligible. If remote exits, fallback immediately chooses eligible host; both outside causes return. No direct voice-issued MoveTo bypass.

cases.arrange: Use each eligible player around both shelf loop routes; later place both players outside each of3exits.
cases.act: Sample ghost root world position, capsule dimensions, accepted waypoints, OutsideBoundViolations and CatchCount through pursuit, voice pause, retargeting, exit and return.
cases.accept: Capsule center stays within store marginsradius+5cm (withradius34: X3989..5911,Y±777.667), feet within80cm of floor; OutsideBoundViolations stays at baseline. Paths reject shelves/partial/wrongfloor as before; no player movement/health changes from phrase reactions.

cases.arrange: No active PTT or decoded speech in recognition grace window.
cases.act: Call the owning local MallVoiceComponent.SubmitRecognizedPhrase with an allowed ID; observe server receiver count/feedback.
cases.accept: Transport refuses phrase because no recent decoded speech/PTT. This intentionally must not trigger the ghost and is distinct from direct receiver tests.

cases.arrange: Two players/headsets, inside test store, no editor test injection.
cases.act: Hold configured V push-to-talk, say each phrase clearly, release. Observe local microphone level/recognizer readiness and server heard feedback, remote proximity playback and ghost reaction.
cases.accept: Actual voice produces packets, offline recognition selects intended ID, server derives real speaker and accepts within store/range, ghost reacts on peers. Walk away to compare attenuation. This human hardware/network test remains pending unless real audio was exercised; synthetic recognition and receiver API calls do not substitute.

finish: Stop state/visual recordings and PIE explicitly.
Verify PIE is inactive and editor packages are unchanged/clean.
Record which cases executed and which remain pending; save results separately from this prepared plan.
